data_description.lights: Lights controlled by this profile. You can leave the list empty.
data_description.interval: How often Circadian Pro recalculates and applies the light settings.
data_description.transition: Transition time during regular adaptation, including automatic sleep-mode entry and exit.
data_description.initial_transition: Transition time for the first change when turning on a light.
data_description.min_color_temp: Lowest color temperature in the daily cycle. Lower values produce warmer colors.
data_description.max_color_temp: Highest color temperature in the daily cycle. Higher values produce cooler colors.
data_description.sleep_rgb_or_color_temp: How color is defined in sleep mode.
data_description.sleep_color_temp: Color temperature used in sleep mode when “Define with color temperature” is selected.
data_description.sleep_rgb_color: RGB color used in sleep mode when “Define with RGB” is selected. On RGBW or RGB+CCT lights, the dedicated white channels are turned off.
data_description.sleep_transition: Transition time when manually enabling/disabling sleep mode with its switch. Automatic sleep mode uses the general transition.
data_description.sleep_schedule_start:
Start of the automatic schedule. Only used with “By schedule”.
Use HH:MM:SS; for example, 23:00:00.
data_description.sleep_schedule_end:
End of the automatic schedule. Only used with “By schedule”.
The schedule can cross midnight; for example, 23:00:00 to 05:00:00.
data_description.take_over_control: Pause adaptation of a light when another action changes its brightness or color.
data_description.sunrise_offset_minutes: Adjust sunrise in whole minutes. Positive values delay it and negative values bring it forward. For example, 30 delays it by half an hour.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Adjust sunset in whole minutes. Positive values delay it and negative values bring it forward. For example, 60 delays it by one hour.
data_description.sunrise_time: Use this sunrise time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunrise from your location and the date.
data_description.min_sunrise_time: Prevent the profile sunrise from occurring before this time. Leave it empty to apply no lower limit.
data_description.max_sunrise_time: Prevent the profile sunrise from occurring after this time. Leave it empty to apply no upper limit.
data_description.sunset_time: Use this sunset time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunset from your location and the date.
data_description.min_sunset_time: Prevent the profile sunset from occurring before this time. Leave it empty to apply no lower limit.
data_description.max_sunset_time: Prevent the profile sunset from occurring after this time. Leave it empty to apply no upper limit.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark:
Duration of the nighttime portion of the transition: before sunrise and after sunset.
Used only in Linear and Sigmoid modes. A higher value lengthens this portion; Natural ignores it.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light:
Duration of the daytime portion of the transition: after sunrise and before sunset.
Used only in Linear and Sigmoid modes. A higher value lengthens this portion; Natural ignores it.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_dark_minutes:
Starts the increase earlier, before sunrise.
Extends the decrease after sunset.
Affects brightness and, when checked, color temperature too.
data_description.brightness_mode_time_light_minutes:
Extends the increase after sunrise.
Starts the decrease earlier, before sunset.
Affects brightness and, when checked, color temperature too.
data_description.sleep_activation_mode:
Disabled: sleep mode is activated only by its manual switch.
By sunrise and sunset: active between the profile sunset and sunrise.
By schedule: active during the schedule below.
The manual switch can activate sleep mode at any time.
data_description.autoreset_control_seconds: Time before Circadian Pro resumes control after a manual change. Use 0 to disable automatic resumption.
data_description.brightness_mode:
Natural: keeps maximum brightness during the day; at night, brightness falls and rises again towards sunrise. It does not apply to color temperature, which follows its independent solar curve. It ignores the two transition times.
Linear: changes brightness at a constant rate. Each transition lasts the sum of the two times.
Sigmoid: uses an S curve, gentle at the ends and faster in the middle. The two times set the main part of the transition.
In Linear and Sigmoid, color temperature also follows its solar curve unless you check “Also apply to color temperature”.
In Linear and Sigmoid, each time accepts whole minutes from 0 to 240.
data_description.apply_temperature_curve: Shares the curve and timing between brightness and color temperature, each within its own limits. This also replaces the nighttime color temperature progression. Sleep mode keeps its own settings.
data_description.detect_non_ha_changes: Detect changes made directly on a light or through another system. Requires “Pause adaptation after manual changes”. Requests a light state update at every adaptation interval; disable this if the light reports unreliable states.
data_description.only_once: Adapt lights when they turn on, then leave their settings unchanged. When disabled, adaptation continues while the lights are on.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Send separate light.turn_on calls for brightness and color. Useful for lights that cannot apply both in one command.
data_description.send_split_delay: Wait this many milliseconds between the separate brightness and color commands.
data_description.adapt_delay: Wait this many seconds after a light turns on before adapting it. This can help prevent flickering.
data_description.skip_redundant_commands: Skip commands when the target already matches the light state reported to Home Assistant. Reduces network traffic. Disable this if the reported state differs from the actual light state.
data_description.intercept: Add the adapted brightness and color to light.turn_on calls before they reach the light. Disable this if the light cannot handle the combined command.
data_description.multi_light_intercept: Also intercept commands targeting several lights. A single call may be split into several calls. Requires “Adapt turn-on commands immediately”.
data_description.prefer_rgb_color: Use RGB rather than the native color temperature mode when the light supports both.
data_description.take_over_control_mode: Pause both brightness and color, or only the setting that was changed manually. Requires “Pause adaptation after manual changes”.
data_description.adapt_only_on_bare_turn_on: When a light turns on, adapt it only if the command does not specify brightness or color. Helps preserve scenes. Requires “Pause adaptation after manual changes”.
data_description.include_config_in_attributes: Expose the profile settings in the main switch’s attributes for inspection and automations.
data_description.transition_until_sleep: Compatibility setting for older profiles. Use “Automatic sleep mode activation” to choose how sleep mode starts.
data_description.sleep_schedule_enabled: Compatibility setting for older profiles. Use “By schedule” under “Automatic sleep mode activation” instead.
data_description.sunrise_offset: Shift sunrise by this many seconds. Positive values delay it; negative values bring it forward.
data_description.sunset_offset: Shift sunset by this many seconds. Positive values delay it; negative values bring it forward.

white_w_kelvin.title: White channel (W)
white_w_kelvin.description: Enter the actual color temperature of the dedicated white channel (W) in your RGBW strip, for example 3000 K.

data_description.white_w_kelvin: Actual color temperature of the white LED. Sets the point where W starts changing from the white level calibrated at 4000 K towards the level calibrated at 1000 K. This changeover point is limited to the range between the two references.

white_channels.title: Warm white and cool white channels
white_channels.description: Enter the actual color temperatures of the warm white (WW) and cool white (CW) LEDs in your RGB+CCT strip. These hardware values are independent of the 4000 K and 1000 K visual references.

data_description.white_w_kelvin: Actual color temperature of the warm white LED. Must be lower than the cool white temperature.
data_description.white_cw_kelvin: Actual color temperature of the cool white LED, for example 6500 K. If omitted in YAML or action settings, the light’s maximum color temperature is used, or 6500 K if unavailable.

cal_neutral.title: 4000 K calibration
cal_neutral.description: Adjust RGB for your 4000 K visual reference. RGBW lights add one white intensity control; RGB+CCT lights also add the warm/cool white mixture temperature.

data_description.cal_white_intensity_neutral:
RGBW: W channel intensity.
RGB+CCT: total warm and cool white intensity, with the mixture set separately.
data_description.cal_white_kelvin_neutral: Temperature of the white mixture at the 4000 K visual reference, between the physical WW and CW temperatures. RGB remains independently adjustable.
data_description.cal_rgb_neutral_r: Intensity of the red channel at the 4000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).
data_description.cal_rgb_neutral_g: Intensity of the green channel at the 4000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).
data_description.cal_rgb_neutral_b: Intensity of the blue channel at the 4000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).

cal_warm.title: 1000 K calibration
cal_warm.description: Adjust RGB for your 1000 K visual reference. White intensity appears only when a selected light supports RGBW or RGB+CCT; keeping it low lets RGB create a warm/orange appearance.

data_description.cal_white_intensity_warm: White intensity at the 1000 K visual reference. In RGB+CCT, only warm white is used here; normally keep white low so RGB can produce the warm/orange appearance.
data_description.cal_rgb_warm_r: Intensity of the red channel at the 1000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).
data_description.cal_rgb_warm_g: Intensity of the green channel at the 1000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).
data_description.cal_rgb_warm_b: Intensity of the blue channel at the 1000 K visual reference, from 0 (off) to 255 (full intensity).

entity_id.name: Profile switch
entity_id.description: Main Circadian Pro switch for the profile whose settings you want to use.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Lights to control. Leave empty to use all lights assigned to the profile.

manual_control.name: Manual control
manual_control.description: Choose whether to pause brightness and color, pause only one of them, or resume automatic adaptation.

change_switch_settings.name: Change profile settings
change_switch_settings.description: Changes the running profile settings. Changes made with this action are temporary and reset when the integration reloads; use the Circadian Pro panel to save settings permanently.

brightness_mode.name: Brightness / color temperature mode
brightness_mode.description: Choose the brightness curve: Natural follows the solar cycle; Linear changes at a constant rate; Sigmoid uses an S curve with gentler ends. In Linear and Sigmoid, the curve can also control color temperature when “Also apply to color temperature” is enabled. This action uses seconds for the transition times.

apply_temperature_curve.name: Also apply to color temperature
apply_temperature_curve.description: Shares the curve and timing between brightness and color temperature, each within its own limits. This also replaces the nighttime color temperature progression. Sleep mode keeps its own settings.

brightness_mode_time_light.name: After sunrise / before sunset (s)
brightness_mode_time_light.description: Duration in seconds after sunrise and before sunset, used by Linear and Sigmoid. If both durations are zero, targets change at sunrise and sunset; the configured light transition still applies.

brightness_mode_time_dark.name: Before sunrise / after sunset (s)
brightness_mode_time_dark.description: Duration in seconds before sunrise and after sunset, used by Linear and Sigmoid. If both durations are zero, targets change at sunrise and sunset; the configured light transition still applies.

entity_id.name: Profile switch
entity_id.description: Main Circadian Pro switch for the profile whose settings you want to use.

use_defaults.name: Unspecified settings
use_defaults.description: For settings omitted from this action, keep their current values, use the saved profile configuration, or use factory defaults.

include_config_in_attributes.name: Show configuration in entity attributes
include_config_in_attributes.description: Expose the profile settings in the main switch’s attributes for inspection and automations.

white_w_kelvin.name: White or warm white temperature (K)
white_w_kelvin.description: Actual color temperature of W for RGBW, or warm white (WW) for RGB+CCT. For RGB+CCT, it must be lower than the cool white (CW) temperature.

white_cw_kelvin.name: Cool white temperature (CW, K)
white_cw_kelvin.description: Actual color temperature of the cool white channel in RGB+CCT. If omitted, use the light’s maximum color temperature, or 6500 K if unavailable.

cal_white_kelvin_neutral.name: Neutral white mixture temperature (K)
cal_white_kelvin_neutral.description: Temperature of the RGB+CCT white mixture at the 4000 K visual reference, between the actual warm and cool white temperatures. RGB and total white intensity remain independent. If omitted, 4000 K is used within that range.

turn_on_lights.name: Turn on lights
turn_on_lights.description: This field is not used by “Change profile settings”. To turn on lights that are off, use “Apply current settings” with “Turn on lights” enabled.

initial_transition.name: Initial transition (s)
initial_transition.description: Transition time for the first change when turning on a light.

sleep_transition.name: Manual sleep mode transition (s)
sleep_transition.description: Transition time when manually enabling/disabling sleep mode with its switch. Automatic sleep mode uses the general transition.

max_color_temp.name: Maximum color temperature (K)
max_color_temp.description: Highest color temperature in the daily cycle. Higher values produce cooler colors.

min_color_temp.name: Minimum color temperature (K)
min_color_temp.description: Lowest color temperature in the daily cycle. Lower values produce warmer colors.

only_once.name: Adapt only when turned on
only_once.description: Adapt lights when they turn on, then leave their settings unchanged. When disabled, adaptation continues while the lights are on.

prefer_rgb_color.name: Prefer RGB color
prefer_rgb_color.description: Use RGB rather than the native color temperature mode when the light supports both.

separate_turn_on_commands.name: Send brightness and color separately
separate_turn_on_commands.description: Send separate light.turn_on calls for brightness and color. Useful for lights that cannot apply both in one command.

send_split_delay.name: Delay between separate commands (ms)
send_split_delay.description: Wait this many milliseconds between the separate brightness and color commands.

sleep_rgb_or_color_temp.name: Sleep mode: define with
sleep_rgb_or_color_temp.description: How color is defined in sleep mode.

sleep_rgb_color.name: Sleep mode: RGB color
sleep_rgb_color.description: RGB color used in sleep mode when “Define with RGB” is selected. On RGBW or RGB+CCT lights, the dedicated white channels are turned off.

sleep_color_temp.name: Sleep mode: color temperature (K)
sleep_color_temp.description: Color temperature used in sleep mode when “Define with color temperature” is selected.

sunrise_offset.name: Sunrise offset (s)
sunrise_offset.description: Shift sunrise by this many seconds. Positive values delay it; negative values bring it forward.

sunrise_time.name: Fixed sunrise time
sunrise_time.description: Use this sunrise time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunrise from your location and the date.

sunset_offset.name: Sunset offset (s)
sunset_offset.description: Shift sunset by this many seconds. Positive values delay it; negative values bring it forward.

sunset_time.name: Fixed sunset time
sunset_time.description: Use this sunset time every day. Leave it empty to calculate sunset from your location and the date.

max_sunrise_time.name: Latest sunrise
max_sunrise_time.description: Prevent the profile sunrise from occurring after this time. Leave it empty to apply no upper limit.

min_sunset_time.name: Earliest sunset
min_sunset_time.description: Prevent the profile sunset from occurring before this time. Leave it empty to apply no lower limit.

take_over_control.name: Pause adaptation after manual changes
take_over_control.description: Pause adaptation of a light when another action changes its brightness or color.

take_over_control_mode.name: What to pause after manual changes
take_over_control_mode.description: Pause both brightness and color, or only the setting that was changed manually. Requires “Pause adaptation after manual changes”.

detect_non_ha_changes.name: Detect non-Home Assistant changes
detect_non_ha_changes.description: Detect changes made directly on a light or through another system. Requires “Pause adaptation after manual changes”. Requests a light state update at every adaptation interval; disable this if the light reports unreliable states.

transition.name: Transition (s)
transition.description: Transition time during regular adaptation, including automatic sleep-mode entry and exit.

adapt_delay.name: Adaptation delay after turn-on (s)
adapt_delay.description: Wait this many seconds after a light turns on before adapting it. This can help prevent flickering.

autoreset_control_seconds.name: Resume automatic control after (s)
autoreset_control_seconds.description: Time before Circadian Pro resumes control after a manual change. Use 0 to disable automatic resumption.
